rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=2, train_n=400, n_iter=30, val_n=200, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.002, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.0002, outer_wall_s=900, seed=42, rationale=iter-11 dual_domain_bilateral_n2i, ONE-KNOB: per-scene Adam lr 0.005->0.002 (gentler optimization), on iter-7 CHAMPION base (img_sr=0.0002, img_kernel=7 default, n_iter=30). img_kernel REVERTED to 7 (iter-10 kernel 7->5 gave hr=0.1260 = TIED with iter-7 0.1261 on a clean val_n=200 -> kernel is NEUTRAL; the tight range sigma, not window size, sets edge-preservation). PLATEAU: iters 5,7,10 all cluster at hr~0.126 (img_sr-driven ceiling). HYPOTHESIS: the N2I self-sup target is the noisy 64-view half-FBP, so each Adam step pulls the BF PARTLY toward that noise floor; at lr=5e-3 the 30-step fit may OVERSHOOT the sweet spot (denoised but sharp) toward the noisy target. A gentler lr=2e-3 lets the fit settle MORE PRECISELY at the edge-preserving optimum before drifting toward noise -> hr could edge above 0.126. If FLAT/DROP, the 30-step fit is already well-damped and lr is neutral -> the ~0.126 plateau is the genuine edge-preserving N2I ceiling on dense breast. BUDGET: same step count, ~700-950s, val_n=200 expected. ONE knob: lr 0.005->0.002.
